title: The Listening Chamber
text: A round chamber of smooth black stone, the floor polished like a drum skin. Every whisper carries for miles, down through cracks into the dark. Something deep below is listening for footsteps. Once, faintly, it taps back.

options.label: Everyone creeps across, soft as breath, and prays the floor stays silent.

outcomes.text: Nothing hears. Every heartbeat sounds like a drum, and you feel each one.
Something hears, and it comes up through the cracks.

options.label: Shout a challenge down into the dark, and let it know you are not afraid.

outcomes.text: It comes up, and it is not afraid either.

options.label: The sharpest ear listens back, to learn what listens below.

outcomes.text: They hear it all: where it sleeps, where it eats, where it keeps its things.
